name: Tutankhamun
subtitle: Curse of the Pharaoh
description: Spread curses and corrode your foes on the Desert Sands dealing terror to grave robbers and looters!
lore: The “boy king,” whose predecessors had turned to other faiths, restored worship of Aaru’s pantheon. Although deathly ill before his eighteenth birthday, Tutankhamun awoke in Ryven rather than dying. Here he mastered the curses meant to protect his tomb, turning them against Aaru’s enemies—but also, in newly inflated zealotry, against some of his own people who he feels are lacking in faith.
divinity_generator: Gain [25] Divinity when enemies are damaged by [Acid].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%
Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%

skills.name: All Things Must Perish
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 125%ATK3 times. The first hit has a 70% chance to place [mechanic:drain-i] on the target for 2turns. The second hit has 70% chance to place [mechanic:vulnerable-i] on the target for 2 turns. If the target is under [Vulnerable] and [Curse], activate [mechanic:acid] on the target.

skills.name: Eternal Curse
skills.description: Attack all enemies 300%ATK with a 50% chance to extend the duration of [Curse] and [mechanic:acid] on each target by 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also, has a 50% chance to place [Acid] on all targets under [Curse] for 1 turn.

skills.name: Blighted Strike
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 170%ATK2 times with a 30% chance to place [mechanic:acid] on the target for 1 turn. If the target is under [Curse], will place [mechanic:acid] for 2 Turns.

skills.name: Curse of the Pharaoh
skills.description: Attacks have a 100% chance to place [mechanic:curse-i] on the target for 1 turns.

imprint_passive: Attacks have a 50% chance to place [Curse I] on the target for 1 turns.
